logo.placement: Place only on dark AMI fields so the white tagline stays visible. Do not redraw, recolor, crop, animate, or place on people, vehicles, uniforms, or generated scenes.

fonts.source: Live AMI homepage CSS custom properties

notes: Live lime #4FA63B is the brand green used on the AMI I and spray. White-on-lime at body size failed WCAG in the July Lighthouse capture (about 3.06:1). Use lime as a large accent only. Body links use #146C43.
Cover and end-card field is the live green-blue stack: forest #1A3A2A, teal #163040, deep #0B1620.
White display type sits on that deep field, not on lime.
